test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of economic development in action?

options.text: A country lowering its interest rates

solution:
The correct answer is __**Improved access to employment opportunities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Economic development refers to qualitative improvements in living standards, employment opportunities, and overall socio-economic well-being of a society.
 
• Improved access to employment opportunities facilitates income generation, poverty reduction, and enhances the quality of life for individuals and communities.
 
• It helps in reducing unemployment rates and increasing productivity, contributing to sustainable economic growth.
 
• Examples of initiatives fostering employment include skill development programs, creation of new industries, and government policies supporting job creation.
 
• Enhanced employment access is a direct measure of economic development as it addresses both economic and social disparities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Economic Development:** A process where the economic well-being and quality of life of a nation, region, or local community are improved.
 
• **Unemployment:** A key indicator of economic health; reducing unemployment signifies progress in development.
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):** Employment creation aligns with SDG 8 – "Decent Work and Economic Growth."
 
• **Skill Development Programs:** Initiatives like India’s Skill India Mission aim to equip individuals with employable skills to enhance economic opportunities.
 
• **Social Equity:** Improved employment access often leads to reduced income inequality and promotes inclusive growth.
